- Overestimate prices after sentiment spikes (especially >0.36) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is low (<0.18) — add 2–5% to forecast to account for mean reversion.
- Forecast tends to lag 1–2 days in downward moves — adjust downward by 1–2% for the next 2–3 days.
- Overshoots after sharp upward moves — cap forecast at 10% above recent high if sentiment >0.4.
- When sentiment is rising (0.2–0.4), forecast should be slightly conservative — reduce 3–5% from model’s peak.
- If sentiment drops sharply (e.g., from 0.4 to 0.1), forecast should not drop below 10% below recent low — avoid premature bottoming.
